sources: recreation.gov public search API per-site catalog for facility 10227380 (catx.py), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10227380 (notice: 'No utility hookups are avaliable.'; all 29 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC in the catalog), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 29 reservable RV/tent sites with paved parking stalls. Per-site max vehicle lengths on recreation.gov run 18-64 ft; 16 sites take 40 ft or more and 5 are under 23 ft. Vehicles that do not fit the spur pay $5 and park in the day-use area.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10227380 ('29 individual RV/Tent campsites', 'a paved parking stall', 'Vehicles that do not fit will be charged an additional vehicle fee of $5.00 and must park in the day-use area') + recreation.gov per-site catalog (catx.py: max vehicle length 18-64 ft), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Flush toilets are seasonal (recreation.gov). Campground hosts on site; day-use area with two beaches, roped swim area and a paved boat launch.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10227380 ('Accessible vault toilets, accessible flush toilets, drinking water and trash receptacles are available throughout the campground', amenities 'Flush Toilets (Seasonal)') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/seeley-lake-campground ('Flush toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The Friday before Memorial Day to the Tuesday after Labor Day, when the gate closes (Forest Service: 'Open May 22, 2026 - September 8, 2026'). Roads are not plowed and the gate is closed in early spring and late fall.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/seeley-lake-campground ('Seasons of Use: Open May 22, 2026 - September 8, 2026') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10227380 ('available for reservation the Friday before Memorial Day to the Tuesday after Labor Day, when the campground gate closes for the season'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'All campsites at the Seeley Lake Campground are available for reservations at www.recreation.gov.' recreation.gov rules: 16 consecutive nights, 32 nights a year. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 1 p.m.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/seeley-lake-campground ('All campsites ... are available for reservations at www.recreation.gov') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10227380 (rules: maxConsecutiveStay 16 consecutive nights, maxStay 32 nights each year; check-in/out notice), read 2026-10-22

note: USFS Lolo NF campground on the west shore of Seeley Lake (Seeley Lake Ranger District), among old-growth western larch, with a boat launch and day-use beach. The Boy Scout Road bridge from town is permanently closed: come in from the north via MT-83 and Boy Scout Road. --Claude
summary: Forest Service-run (Seeley Lake RD), all sites reservable on recreation.gov. Confirmed 29 non-electric sites with no hookups, drinking water, flush+vault toilets, $20 rate (fees left as recorded); added sewer none, season May 22 - Sept 8 (Friday before Memorial Day - Tuesday after Labor Day), 16-night limit. Changed max_rig_ft 32 -> 64 (rec.gov catalog). Not stated: fcfs, booking window (inherited 180). No Forest alerts for the campground. Note trimmed of restated values and the '~32 ft' trailer limit the catalog contradicts.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: recreation.gov lists 'Waterfront Sites' and 'Lake Access' among the amenities and the campground is 'located on the western shore of Seeley Lake'; the entry is not waterfront.

Access road: the Boy Scout Road bridge is permanently closed (recreation.gov notice; FS 'bridge closure on Boy Scout Road impacting access from the south'); the campground is reached from the north entrance of Boy Scout Road off MT-83.
Missing phone: Seeley Lake Ranger Station 406-677-2233 (Forest Service page and recreation.gov).
Name: the Forest Service publishes 'Seeley Lake Campground' (recreation.gov 'Seeley Lake Lolo Campground (MT)'); the entry is 'Lolo National Forest, Seeley Lake Campground'.
